notes.title: Free content update: Weeks 9-12, Random Encounters and more!
notes.content:
Hello there!

We are happy to announce a free content update that [b]unlocks weeks 9-12, adds Random Encounters and a Service Pass[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36712176/7eb25d664ff186f7dfd61942f79c9c9d2b1f0bfa.jpg[/img]

Please note that there are [b]no new story elements in this update[/b]. We have concluded the story as of week 8 and we're not actively planning to extend it any further. This update purely adds new gameplay content (tasks, items, etc) and fixes a lot of bugs. The character related storylines are still intact.

Download the update on Steam and check that the game shows [b]version A2024.06.16.1[/b]!

In short:
- 6 new Random Encounters ("Nakki")
- Service Pass ("Palveluspassi") including various new in-game items
- Procedurally generated weeks 9-12 (new military drills, shooting exercises, sports exercises, random encounters, lectures etc).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36712176/9b0e344ee347fd8b4d97a8fbb89205c5fa444c13.png[/img]

[b]The Service Pass is unlocked for free after completing the Basic Period at least once.[/b]

The generated procedural content [b]depends on the name chosen for your character during day one[/b] which means that the player experience will vary. You may encounter totally different service tasks than other players during weeks 9-12.

Happy mornings!

- Jeri, Lead Producer

tags.feature: - 6 new Random Encounters ("Nakki")
- Service Pass ("Palveluspassi") including various new in-game items
- Procedurally generated weeks 9-12 (new military drills, shooting exercises, sports exercises, random encounters, lectures etc).

notes.title: Week 8 and New Game+ game mode have now been unlocked in update A2023.08.20.2!
notes.content:
Week 8 and New Game+ game mode have now been unlocked in update A2023.08.20.2!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36712176/14356e191ca044dee84d9e62bf8a621be3bacb33.png[/img]

Week 8 is the last week of the basic period. From here we will continue a bit differently towards a full 6 month service. We will give more information soon.

There is a known bug in Shooting Practices RK5 and RK6 which sometimes makes the player shoot from outside the shed. We are investigating this. Other than that, the content should work mostly fine.

Please Be Patient.

notes.title: New feature in update A2023.07.22.1: Quick Access Consumable Items!
notes.content:
- Press F to quickly use a selected consumable from your inventory (without opening the Inventory screen). This feature will be useful for maximum performance during various tasks.
- Click a consumable item in your inventory and press "Select" to select the item for Quick Access.
- Also some bug fixes have been implemented.

notes.title: Build A2023.01.14.1
notes.content:
[b]This build has bug fixes for some of the reported bugs, incl. [/b]
- invisible boundaries when returning from holidays, 
- duplicating padlock, 
- Ritokari's glitched freetime dialogue during freetime in English, 
- random sanity drops that were given in the room after making your bed,
- freezing UI not going away after tent watchkeeping,
- Canteen Lady's Pet skill was not functional

[b]I have also added a new Steam leaderboard that shows global high scores after each march to restaurant![/b] This should increase your marching motivation.
